Every field not named below is byte-identical to the record it copies; see X15/logs/04-link-truth-table.txt for the commit facts, and X15/logs/01 and 03 for the scanner defect that had hidden part of it (unit ids ending in a letter were skipped outright, and the script had no exit status).
